name: Human Heart (Anatomical 4-Chamber, Valves & Coronary Circulation)
semanticDescription: Authentic medical-grade human heart model extracted from the Z-Anatomy anatomical atlas with 4 chambers (Left & Right Ventricles, Left & Right Atria), Coronal Cutaway cross-section with ~3x thicker LV myocardium wall (NCERT Class 10 Fig 5.4), Tricuspid & Bicuspid/Mitral valves with chordae tendineae and papillary muscles, Aortic & Pulmonary semilunar valves, Aorta & Aortic Arch with 3 systemic branches (Brachiocephalic, Carotid, Subclavian), Pulmonary Trunk and left/right pulmonary arteries, Superior & Inferior Vena Cava, 4 Pulmonary Veins, and full Coronary Circulation (LAD, RCA, Circumflex, Great & Middle Cardiac Veins, Coronary Sinus).
simplifications: Carotid artery and systemic great vessels trimmed to standard isolated anatomical organ margins (~2.5-3.0 cm above aortic arch, ~2 cm below apex).

Dual-collection architecture: '01_Heart_Chambers_Full' provides complete external muscular organ with coronary circulation; '02_Heart_Chambers_Coronal_Cutaway' provides solidified coronal cross-section exposing all 4 internal cavities and valves (NCERT Fig 5.4).
Left ventricle myocardium authored with 11 mm wall thickness (~3x right ventricle 4 mm wall thickness) reflecting systemic vs pulmonary hydrostatic pressure requirements.
